macros.name: comment
macros.doc: Command \comment{TEXT} inside an EXPRESSION produces TEXT at the side of the paper opposite to the equation number side.

macros.name: doNumber
macros.doc: Command \doNumber inside an EXPRESSION produces an equation number.

macros.name: Hindent
macros.doc: The amount of indentation of the text of a hint, relative to the expressions, is given by \Hindent plus \Hsep (plus the width of \Hblockopen if option block is valid).

macros.name: Hsep
macros.doc: The amount of space between \Hlineopen and the first token of the hint is given by \Hsep.

macros.name: step
macros.doc: Command \step will be invoked inside an expression; thus, briefly said, it should have this effect: “end the expression, begin a new line, print the step symbol and hint, and begin a new expression”.

envs.name: subcalculation
envs.doc: Calculations are allowed inside hints by the subcalculation environment (for small calculations which do not deserve a separate discussion before or after the main calculation), although numbering and commenting is then disabled.
